title: Bartholomew Scultet
summary: Raleigh names Bartholomew Scultet in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Bartholomew Scultet, commended for skill in Astronomie, who by calculation found a day for the Sunnes going backe. Raleigh hath not seene his workes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. I, sig. 350a–350b
